第61章 给媳妇买自行车，买手表-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

国强小店的生意，进了四月之后更红火了。

不光是农机厂的工人来吃，连镇上几个单位的人都开始往这儿跑。

供销社的、邮电局的，甚至镇政府食堂的师傅都偷偷来吃过。

回去还学着做，但怎么做都做不出林国强的味道。

有人问林国强：“林师傅，你这卤肉到底放了什么料？怎么就这么香？”

林国强笑笑，不说话。

不是他藏着掖着，是说了也没用。

卤肉这东西，配方就算告诉你，但火候、时间、手感这些东西，不是听一遍就能会的。

他在前世在县城里当帮厨那十多年，看了孙师傅做了几百锅卤肉，自己又练了不知多少回，才有今天的味道。

四月初十，林国强算了算账。

开店三个多月，除去成本、房租、工资，净赚了将近三千块。

三千块。

在1981年的农村，这是一笔大钱。

一个壮劳力在生产队干一年，年底分红也就百十来块。

他三个月就赚了别人二三十年的钱。

林国强把钱分成几份。

留出两千块做周转资金，三百块存起来备急用，剩下的几百块，他打算花掉一些。

“志军，明天你跟我去趟县城。”

赵志军正在擦桌子，听见这话，眼睛一亮：“去县城干啥？”

“买点东西。”

“买啥？”

“到了你就知道了。”

赵志军嘿嘿笑了，也不追问，擦桌子擦得更卖力了。

第二天一早，林国强和赵志军坐镇上的拖拉机去了县城。

到了县城，林国强先去了百货大楼。

他在自行车柜台前停下来，看了看玻璃柜台后面那排崭新的自行车。

飞鸽、永久、凤凰，一辆一辆地排着，车架上的黑漆锃亮，在日光灯下泛着光。

“同志，这辆二八大杠多少钱？”

林国强指了指一辆黑色的永久。

“一百八。”售货员头都没抬。

“那辆女式的呢？”

他指了指旁边一辆小巧的自行车，车架是弯的，颜色是墨绿色的，车把上系着一根红色的塑料飘带。

“凤凰牌的，二十六寸，一百六。”

林国强想了想，从口袋里掏出一沓钱，数了三百四十块，放在柜台上。

“两辆都要了。”

The business of Guoqiang's store has become even more prosperous since April.

Not only workers from the agricultural machinery factory came to eat, but also people from several units in the town started to come here.

Workers from the supply and marketing cooperative, the post and telecommunications office, and even the chefs from the town government cafeteria came to eat secretly.

I still learned to make it when I went back, but no matter how I tried it, I couldn't make it taste like Lin Guoqiang.

Someone asked Lin Guoqiang: "Master Lin, what ingredients did you put in this braised pork? Why is it so fragrant?"

Lin Guoqiang smiled and said nothing.

It wasn't that he was hiding it, it was that it was useless even if he said it.

Even if I tell you the recipe for braised pork, the heat, time, and texture cannot be mastered just by listening to it.

In his previous life, when he worked as a cook in the county town for more than ten years, he watched Master Sun make hundreds of pots of braised pork, and he practiced it countless times before he got the taste he has today.

On April 10th, Lin Guoqiang settled the accounts.

After opening the store for more than three months, after excluding costs, rent, and wages, the net profit was nearly 3,000 yuan.

Three thousand dollars.

In rural areas in 1981, this was a lot of money.

If a strong laborer works in the production team for a year, the dividend at the end of the year will only be about 100 yuan.

In three months, he made what others had earned in 20 or 30 years.

Lin Guoqiang divided the money into several parts.

He set aside two thousand yuan as working capital, saved three hundred yuan for emergencies, and planned to spend some of the remaining several hundred yuan.

"Zhijun, come with me to the county town tomorrow."

Zhao Zhijun was cleaning the table. When he heard this, his eyes lit up: "Why are you going to the county town?"

"Buy something."

"What to buy?"

"You'll know when we get there."

Zhao Zhijun chuckled and wiped the table harder without asking any questions.

Early the next morning, Lin Guoqiang and Zhao Zhijun took the town's tractor to the county seat.

When he arrived at the county town, Lin Guoqiang first went to the department store.

He stopped at the bike counter and looked at the row of brand new bikes behind the glass counter.

Flying Pigeon, Forever, and Phoenix were lined up one by one, the black paint on the frames shining brightly under the fluorescent lamps.

"Comrade, how much does this 28-inch big bar cost?"

Lin Guoqiang pointed to a black permanent car.

"One hundred and eighty." The salesman didn't even raise his head.

"Where's the women's car?"

He pointed to a small bicycle next to him. The frame was curved and dark green in color. There was a red plastic streamer tied to the handlebars.

"Phoenix brand, twenty-six inches, one hundred and six inches."

Lin Guoqiang thought for a while, took out a wad of money from his pocket, counted three hundred and forty yuan, and put it on the counter.

"I want both."
